test.create_query: CREATE TABLE for_each_bench (k UInt32, arr Array(Float64)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO for_each_bench SELECT number % 1000, arrayMap(i -> toFloat64(i + number), range(32)) FROM numbers(2000000)

test.create_query: CREATE TABLE for_each_bench_nullable (k UInt32, arr Array(Nullable(Float64)), full Array(Nullable(Float64))) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO for_each_bench_nullable SELECT number % 1000, arrayMap(i -> if((i + number) % 8 = 0, NULL, toFloat64(i + number)), range(32)), arrayMap(i -> toNullable(toFloat64(i + number)), range(32)) FROM numbers(2000000)
